title: Builder BLD-202: Add by intent

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-202.

detail: B2 Roles, pass BLD-202 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-202). Add by intent. Scope: components/builder/add. Build: + opens 'What should this part do?' with the intents, grouped (21 roles in builder v3). Previews render each role's default variant with the Space's own data where role.data is set, else the flagged sample. Insert at the chosen index; select it; one undo step. Done when: Only roles legal for the current kind and surface are offered; Preview uses Space data when present. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), check:theme-conformance, a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-201, BLD-103. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-202.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
